passives.name: Master of All Gold
passives.description: (Passive Effect) At the start of the turn, when all surviving allies are not inflicted with Stunned, grants an irremovable Invulnerability to the caster for 1 turn. When the caster is inflicted with Stunned, increases damage taken. After the Boss is inflicted with Break, irremovable Invulnerability is no longer granted. If an ally is inflicted with a debuff when hit, reduces Priority of all allies by 50%. (Only once per turn)
